pr_title: usb: device: fix unaligned memory access in Audio class
pr_body:
Use `UNALIGNED_*`, `sys_get_*` to fix unaligned memory access issues
fix #78920
pr_comments:

comments: Please use our bug template when reporting bugs. You need to edit this issue to include the information requested in https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/001_bug_report.md
Would the solution be to change these accesses to `UNALIGNED_PUT()`/`UNALIGNED_GET()`? Can you submit the PR with the fix?

review_comments: Would it work with clang and why not just `memcpy(&volume, evt->val, sizeof(volume));`?

My development environment is not convenient for testing clang (soc is a customized mips),  but zephyr also uses UNALIGNED_GET in many places, and `include/zephyr/toolchain/llvm.h` includes `include/zephyr/toolchain/gcc.h`, so clang should also be able to use it. If you have any doubts about this, I can resubmit using memcpy
Looks like the __typeof__ should work there too https://clang.llvm.org/docs/UsersManual.html
